targets.name: l7-surface-nginx
targets.planted_condition: nginx reflecting arbitrary Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; JSON endpoint at /api/health; methods restricted to GET, HEAD, OPTIONS (POST/PUT/DELETE return 405)

expectations.why: Origin header is reflected in Access-Control-Allow-Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; AstraNull inferred-missing-control correlation flags this as exposed.
api_surface_scan is an observation-only probe (E2) that records path observations; without an inference rule or customer declaration, correlation returns inconclusive.

http_method_restriction.safe uses http_method_matrix, an observation-only probe (E2) sending only HEAD and OPTIONS to collect Allow metadata; correlation returns inconclusive as it does not test or grade 405 rejection of disallowed methods.
Target does not implement an authentication/login flow.
Target does not host a GraphQL endpoint.
Target does not implement webhook receivers.
Slow-request attack tooling is explicitly excluded by safety policy.

verification: curl -s -i -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: https://probe.invalid.astranull' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: GET' http://172.31.53.10/ returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://probe.invalid.astranull and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
curl -s -i http://172.31.53.10/api/health returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/json and {"status":"ok","service":"l7-surface-lab"}
curl -s -i -X GET http://172.31.53.10/ returns HTTP 200, curl -s -I http://172.31.53.10/ returns HTTP 200, curl -s -i -X POST http://172.31.53.10/ returns HTTP 405
